The u=exp(-2*kappa a) transformation yields the exact mixture. Hausdorff uniqueness establishes injectivity, while nondecreasing left-continuous q=u*g with finite positive endpoint reconstructs exactly a right-continuous survival S and mean 1/(2*kappa*c). For every integer K the (K+1)st compactly supported derivative has zero moments through K, and small perturbations preserve density positivity, survival monotonicity and the mean. The oscillatory q-derivative construction has TV(Pn,P0)=O(1/n) but TV(Tn,T0) -> epsilon/pi integral u*eta>0 by averaging |cos|. The reproducibility script passed 45 exact-arithmetic assertions. Finite checks do not prove infinite results; the proof provides those steps.

value.rationale: This is a motivated stochastic-reset calibration inverse problem, not merely a known forward OU moment substitution. It gives an exact physical admissibility criterion for complete one-time distributions, proves a strong finite-moment observational obstruction at any prescribed reset mean, and constructs severe TV inverse instability even in smooth positive fixed-mean laws. These separate ideal identifiability from realistic measurement inference without claiming a finite-sample estimator.
